product_updates.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
product_updates.content: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.

product_updates.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
product_updates.content: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

product_updates.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
product_updates.content: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
product_updates.content: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
product_updates.content: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

product_updates.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
product_updates.content: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

product_updates.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
product_updates.content: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.

product_updates.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
product_updates.content: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

product_updates.title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
product_updates.content: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.
